title: Reporting
description: Freshness and performance of the scheduled reporting beat tasks (loan portfolio, income statement, savings statement, fee collection).

panels.title: Materialization duration (p50/p95/p99) by report type
panels.query: histogram_quantile(0.5 | 0.95 | 0.99, sacco_report_materialize_duration_seconds{report_type=*}) over the selected time range, grouped by report_type label.

panels.title: Materialization duration trend
panels.query: avg(sacco_report_materialize_duration_seconds{report_type=*}) plotted over time, one series per report_type label.

panels.title: Last run recency by report type
panels.query: now() - sacco_report_last_run_timestamp{report_type=*} (seconds since last successful materialization), one value per report_type label. A large/growing value indicates the beat task has stopped running.

panels.title: Last run timestamp trend
panels.query: sacco_report_last_run_timestamp{report_type=*} plotted over time, one series per report_type label — a step function that should advance roughly on schedule; a flat line signals a stalled beat task.
